newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 21.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Nov. 21:

WASHINGTON - Federal regulators are about to make a $682.5 million decision: should the government grant a satellite TV license to MCI Communications Corp in the face of fierce opposition from the cable TV industry.

WASHINGTON - The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency issued a package of rules that would allow national banks to apply individually for expanded powers to underwrite and sell securities and insurance.
WASHINGTON - LCI International Inc. announced it would move to a new headquarters in Arlington, Va., and more than quadruple its area workforce to 1,500 people in the next few years.
WASHINGTON - Loews Corp.'s investment in drilling rig pays off big in the newly thriving Gulf of Mexico.
